message.subject: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
message.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for your quotation and for considering a longer-term agreement. We value our relationship with Werdenfels and would like to find a package your team can approve.

Our purchase orders with you for part:370010 on 2 and 17 June 2026 were at EUR 5.26/kg (po:4500014022-10, po:4500014078-10), compared with EUR 5.84/kg on 1 and 18 September 2026 (po:4500014355-10, po:4500014427-10).

We propose EUR 4.60/kg for part:370010, payment within 60 days net, a 36-month contract, AS-14404 on a 45% material share, 5% deadband and base month 2026-08.

Our price applies only together with the complete package above. This is a proposal for your approval, not a confirmation of agreement. The fixed terms of our enquiry remain unchanged. Could you issue this complete package as your binding offer? If a term prevents approval, please identify it so we can address it directly.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke
